_comment: Composed fixture: usage_get_summary carries no per-workflow breakdown (byModel/byNode/byProject only), so the UI's byWorkflow figure requires one usage_get_summary({workflowId}) call per known workflow plus one workflow_list_runs({workflowId}) call per workflow for its run count. `overall` and each entry under `byWorkflowId` are each verbatim `summary` payloads from their own live usage_get_summary call; `runCounts` are each verbatim `page.matchedCount` from their own live workflow_list_runs call. See fixtures/README.md.
